verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe a simplified Sessions flow, where the server makes a single /sessions request, and an advanced three-call flow. They also document client support for web, iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter, a test environment with test credentials, and OpenAPI specs that can generate client libraries. That gives a documented path to a working flow. However, the pack has no evidence of copy-paste code samples in multiple server languages and nothing backing a sub-day timeline. Hands-on community reports say Stripe is easier to integrate and describe integration complexity, including one team that spent hundreds of hours, largely on card-present work. Another implementer said the integration was "not as terrible" as claimed, so the reports temper confidence rather than create a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: copy-paste code examples per language, evidence of official server SDKs/quickstarts, independent corroboration of a fast (<1 day) integration.
